message.reasoning:
The user wants a function `wind_chill(velocity, temperature)` that calculates the wind chill index.
The formula for wind chill (in metric units, temperature in Celsius, wind speed in km/h) is:
$WCI = 13.12 + 0.6215 \times T - 11.37 \times V^{0.16} + 0.3965 \times T \times V^{0.16}$
where $T$ is temperature in °C and $V$ is wind speed in km/h.

Let's check the example: `wind_chill(120, 35) == 40`
$T = 35$, $V = 120$
$V^{0.16} = 120^{0.16}$
$\log(120) \approx 2.07918$
$0.16 \times 2.07918 \approx 0.33267$
$10^{0.33267} \approx 2.149$
Actually, $120^{0.16} \approx 2.1493$

$WCI = 13.12 + 0.6215 \times 35 - 11.37 \times 2.1493 + 0.3965 \times 35 \times 2.1493$
$= 13.12 + 21.7525 - 24.442 + 29.816$
$= 40.2465$

Rounded to the next integer: 40. Matches the assertion.
